description: Where RSR will not ship one product, as published in their ship-restrictions file. Shown on the fulfilment screen for staff to read; it never blocks a checkout by itself.

fields.label: RSR Stock #
fields.description: RSR's stock number for the restricted product.

fields.label: Entry Count
fields.description: How many restriction lines the feed carries for this SKU (duplicates included — the count is RSR's, not ours to tidy).

fields.label: Load Batch
fields.description: Which load of the restrictions file produced this row. Only rows from the load recorded in RSR Settings are used, so a load that stopped half-way is never acted on.

fields.label: Entries (JSON)
fields.description: The restriction lines RSR published for this product, in the order they sent them: municipality, state, territory type, restriction detail. Territory type: C = City, T = County, S = State. Restriction detail: Y, F, A and L block a drop-ship outright; H, O, S and R mean the recipient needs a permit; anything else is treated as blocked. Read-only — the next load of the file replaces it.

name: RSR Ship Restriction
